items.title: The time AI saves designers usually disappears. Here's how to keep it.
items.excerpt: Argues that the hours AI tools shave off design production get silently reabsorbed by more output and scope, and lays out practices for designers to reinvest that time in research and judgment.

items.title: Nobody asked for the sparkle button
items.excerpt: A critique of the 'sparkle' AI entry point bolted onto product UIs, arguing AI features should be woven into existing user tasks rather than surfaced as a generic magic button.

items.title: Where to draw the line before AI reaches professional users
items.excerpt: Examines how designers should scope AI automation in professional tools, where errors are costly and expert users need control, review points and clear boundaries.

items.title: I can't decide if this AI billboard is stupid or genius
items.excerpt: Notion's new out-of-home campaign for its AI goes shoulder to shoulder with competitors; Creative Bloq weighs whether the comparative AI billboard design works.

items.title: Etsy's crackdown on AI slop is welcome, but it shows how far things have slipped
items.excerpt: Etsy introduces a rule banning fake AI-generated product photos; Creative Bloq argues a handmade-design marketplace needing such a rule shows how far AI imagery has eroded trust.

items.title: Why do AI platforms want humans to design their branding?
items.excerpt: AI companies keep hiring human designers and agencies for their brand identities rather than generating them, an irony Creative Bloq unpacks.

items.title: New CG software you may have missed: 25 October 2026 (EdenLive real-time AI renderer, KeenFace)
items.excerpt: Round-up includes EdenLive, an open-source model that turns rough blockout animation into near-photorealistic video in real time on one consumer GPU, plus KeenFace AI 3D head generation and an MCP server in Gaffer.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details neural rendering and AI character tooling for its RTX Spark Windows platform for AI development, creation and gaming on slim laptops and compact desktops.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere
items.excerpt: Apple's Creator Studio update brings MotionVFX into Final Cut Pro and adds AI features across its creative apps, alongside long-requested timeline changes.

items.title: StandardFlow launches AI compliance software
items.excerpt: StandardFlow's new software automatically analyses engineering documentation against technical standards, flags compliance gaps and produces source-linked assessments for product development teams.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6.1 Soul and Terra: 3D Model Test Results
items.excerpt: Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Soul and Terra were given the same prompt to build a 3D diecast RX-7 model; one result stood out.

items.title: FLUX 3 Klein Tested: Has AI Image Generation Plateaued?
items.excerpt: Hands-on tests of FLUX 3 Klein's text rendering, image editing and multi-reference generation show mixed, incremental gains over FLUX 2.

items.title: CLI-Anything: Turn Any App Into a CLI for Claude Code and Codex
items.excerpt: CLI-Anything auto-generates command-line interfaces for GIMP, Blender, LibreOffice and more, giving AI coding agents direct access to creative tools.

items.title: AI agent approval UX: show the side effects, not a yes/no
items.excerpt: Design pattern guide for agent approval prompts: show diffs, blast radius and reversibility instead of a yes/no, tier actions by risk and measure rubber-stamping.

items.title: The quality of your AI interface depends on how well it handles errors
items.excerpt: AI demos design for the ideal path; this piece argues AI interface quality is defined by how it designs for failure, ambiguity and recovery states.

items.title: Google's next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic generated worlds and real-time steering, pitched at robotics and film production.

items.title: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
items.excerpt: Apple's new AI assistant can draft and restructure content in Pages, build presentations in Keynote and organise data in Numbers.

items.title: Fast, reliable A2UI, with swappable inference formats
items.excerpt: Google's A2UI generative-UI protocol gets swappable inference formats, including A2UI Express for 3x lower latency and controlled generation with Jev for reliable agent-generated interfaces. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered generative UI this window.)

items.title: Introducing Runway App Studio
items.excerpt: Runway App Studio lets teams build no-code custom AI apps that generate images, video and audio using their Brand Kits and Workflows, shareable across the team. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered it this window.)

items.title: Explore Shaders and Motion with the Figma agent | Figma on Figma
items.excerpt: Figma's own team demos using the Figma agent to create shaders and motion on the canvas in an everyday workflow.

items.title: Config India 2026: When everyone can make anything, how far can we take it?
items.excerpt: teamLab co-founder Daisuke Sakai asks what craft means when everyone can generate images, build software and ship products faster than ever.

items.title: Cook up a billboard-ready visual with Tommaso Baldi in under 30 seconds
items.excerpt: A designer uses Adobe Stock's AI Studio to customise stock assets before licensing them for a restaurant billboard.
